newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Corp introduces direct access notes.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Corp introduces direct access notes.

text.p: The Chicago Corp has introduced a new type of medium-term note designed to provide major corporations with a new source of capital, while meeting the needs of individual investors, the company said.

The product, called a direct access note (DAN), allows individuals to buy fixed-income securities from corporate issuers on an original-issue basis. In turn, the individual investor represents a new capital source for the company, the company said.
General Motors Acceptance Corp, the finance arm of General Motors, will be the first company to launch DANs and will begin offering $500 million worth on Friday, September 27.

GMAC's offering, to be called SmartNotes, will be sold in increments of $1,000 and sold at par, with varying rates and maturities. New rates are announced every Friday and will usually remain available until the following Thursday, according to Chicago Corp.
Chicago Corp, a financial services company, has an agreement to be purchased by ABN-AMRO Bank NV which is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 1996.
